falsification_rules.description: If VNIBOR 20D STRESS/WARNING sessions drop below 5 with ON MA5 20D change turning negative, liquidity squeeze is truly easing
If Breadth MA20 exceeds 45% and sustains for 5+ sessions, market breadth recovery is confirmed not just a technical bounce
If SSI drops below 55% and market state exits EUPHORIC_RISK, accumulated stress is releasing
If EVT xi falls below 0.25 with Hill estimator confirming, fat tail regime ends and tail risk becomes manageable
If Vingroup Slope Percentile stays below 70th AND Correlation Percentile drops below 70th, VIN no longer anchors F1
If CQS Percentile falls below 80th and HY OAS percentile rises above 50th, contagion risk decreases and credit stress is no longer extreme
